payload.title: 25 Most Iconic Celebrity Engagement Rings
payload.excerpt: From Grace Kelly to Taylor Swift: 25 celebrity and royal engagement rings decoded by cut, setting and style, with who each look suits. No price tags.
key_takeaways: Every celebrity ring here belongs to a style family you can ask a jeweller for by name, from the emerald-cut solitaire to the toi et moi.
Royal rings lean on meaning more than size, using heirloom diamonds, birthstones and national colours.
Three-stone and side-stone settings are more common in this list than they first appear, because tapered baguettes are easy to miss in photographs.
For a destination wedding, a low or bezel setting travels better than a tall claw setting, and pearls should come off before the beach.

faq.q: What is the most famous engagement ring in the world?
faq.a: There is no official ranking, but the oval sapphire and diamond ring worn first by Diana and then by Catherine, Princess of Wales, has a strong claim. After the 2010 engagement, US jewellers reported a wave of requests for replicas within days.

faq.q: Why do royals often choose coloured gemstone engagement rings?
faq.a: Often for meaning. Queen Victoria's emerald was reported as her birthstone, and Queen Mary of Denmark's rubies were reported as chosen to echo the Danish flag. Coloured stones also make a ring personal in a way that size alone does not.

faq.q: What engagement ring style is most popular with celebrities right now?
faq.a: In this list, the recent rings are varied: an old mine cut in a bezel, an east-west cushion, a marquise and several ovals. The common thread is an antique cut or an elongated shape rather than a single dominant style.

faq.q: Do celebrity engagement rings usually use yellow gold?
faq.a: Not as a rule. In this list, Meghan, Princess Eugenie and Taylor Swift all wear yellow gold, while Queen Elizabeth II, Grace Kelly and Amal Clooney have platinum.

faq.q: How can you get a celebrity engagement ring look in your own style?
faq.a: Name the style family, not the celebrity. Ask a jeweller for "an emerald-cut solitaire" or "a three-stone with tapered baguettes", then adjust the size, metal and details to your hand and your life. The engagement ring styles guide explains each family.

faq.q: Which celebrity engagement rings have an Australian connection?
faq.a: Two in this list. Queen Mary of Denmark was born in Hobart [[VERIFY: Queen Mary of Denmark Australian-born (Hobart); cite kongehuset.dk or a major outlet]], and Australian-born model Miranda Kerr wears a round three-stone ring.
